image_description: A close-up view of a white toilet paper roll mounted on a metallic holder. The paper is unrolled slightly, revealing a textured, embossed surface pattern (quilted/dotted). The edge of the paper shows a scalloped or perforated tear line. The background includes a beige tiled wall and part of a white fixture (likely a toilet tank or bidet).
